newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Imaging to report gain in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Imaging to report gain in Q4.

text.p: Alliance Imaging Inc said it will report nonrecurring earnings of $0.55 per share in the fourth quarter and other nonrecurring earnings in the first quarter of 1997 due to the repurchase of subordinated debentures and cumulative preferred stock.

It repurchased 7.5 percent senior subordinated debentures and Series A 6 percent cumulative preferred stock. The securities retired carried an aggregate value of $31.6 million and were repurchased for $16.8 million plus interest and dividends, in cash. The repurchase will increase stockholders' equity by $9.6 million, it said.
